dessin:
On the left, top (x 5-30%, y 22-50%): a small city block map seen from above: white streets with ink edges around a block, and one building footprint drawn as a bold ink outline (an L-shaped polygon) in the block.
On the left, bottom (x 6-28%, y 54-80%): the same building drawn as a simple front elevation (flat facade with windows and a flat roof), ink lines.
A thin ink line goes from the right side of the elevation to the right, to a large sheet.
On the right (x 40-72%, y 22-80%): a large pale sheet with a thin double rule at its top (empty header band), divided into three stacked sections separated by thin rules, each with an empty header line at its top:
section 1 (y 30-48%): the L-shaped building footprint as a hatched surface, and beside it three tiny signs in a row: a dot, a short line, a small polygon;
section 2 (y 51-63%): a small attribute table of two rows (empty cells);
section 3 (y 66-79%): a small globe drawn with meridians and parallels, with the L-shaped footprint placed on it.

elements.plan: the city block map with the building footprint, top left
elements.elevation: the building front elevation, bottom left
elements.trait: the thin line from the elevation to the large sheet
elements.feuille: the large sheet on the right (whole sheet)
elements.geometrie: section 1 of the sheet: hatched footprint and the three tiny signs
elements.signes: the three tiny signs (dot, line, polygon) in section 1
elements.attributs: section 2 of the sheet: the small attribute table
elements.coordonnees: section 3 of the sheet: the globe with the footprint
